test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If K ÷ L means that K is the mother of L, K – L means that K is the father of L, K × L means that K is the sister of L, then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal grandmother of R?
solution:
K ÷ L → K is the mother of L

K – L → K is the father of L

K × L→ K is the sister of L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

By drawing family tree using the table above we get,

1) P ÷ Q × R 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bef135ee672ceec98978508435eaabab344576cf263e949d6076b9255f94383d.png] 

Here, P is the father of R. 

2) R – Q ÷ P 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a48abd2f762d65497aef8c944ab08c07d08c382f3ca2f11e2e3bded4f65daec.png] 

Here, P is the Grandchild of R.

**3) P ÷ Q – R **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/236101af680bca05e68669127aba7353c7b7cf64d1c3dab5e48fb89863ec11d7.png] 

**Here, P is the paternal grandmother of R.**

4) Q ÷ P – R 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac7dbd28725dd786a4b4487fb1a1f028d4f1cd93271f1ca6f400d4c2ea0d5401.png] 

Here, P is the father of R.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
